description: Machine-readable KDS Governance Rulebook - companion to kds-rulebook.md

corePrinciples: Governance First - All .github changes through kds.prompt.md gatekeeper
Document First - Update KDS files before code, docs commit before implementation
Test Metadata First - UI/API files include PLAYWRIGHT TEST METADATA for reverse-engineering (Rule #2b)
Honest Handoffs - Agents use JSON + Next Command + HALT (no auto-execution)
Test-Driven - Create tests FIRST (red-green-refactor), prefer headless mode
Holistic Regeneration - Delete & recreate files (no partial edits to prevent duplication)
outputQuality: Concise Format - No code in chat, 3-line bullets max, letter options in ALL CAPS
Key Visibility - Display active key in all headers, phase output, and commands
Per-Task Handoffs - Every task gets dedicated JSON with all parameters pre-populated
workflowStandards: Auto-Chain Defaults - Tasks chain by default, phases need user approval (unless E2E mode)
Phase Isolation - New chat window per phase when autoChain=false (better performance)
Plan Conflicts - Load existing plan, analyze conflicts before routing to existing keys
Test Registry - Central index (.github/tests/), reuse before creating new tests
orchestration: Playwright Pattern - Dotnet orchestration scripts only (Start-Job → dotnet run → Test → Stop-Job)
KDS Cleanup - Review mode detects backup files, archives (not deletes) with manifest
enforcement: 20 Rules - Validated before output (Rules #1-20), each with validation function
Step -1 - Execution prompts include governance enforcement (routers exempt per Rule #18)
Router Exemption - route.prompt.md and ask.prompt.md skip Step -1 to preserve routing workflow
Dual Rulebook Sync - JSON + MD must be updated together atomically (Rule #19 - MANDATORY)
Test Registry (KDTR) - Query before test generation, publish after successful execution (Rule #20)
Test Metadata - ValidateTestMetadata() scans UI/API files for PLAYWRIGHT TEST METADATA blocks
Build Validation - Zero errors required after task/phase completion (Rule #14)
Git History - ValidateGitHistory() analyzes commits for rule violations (Rule #15)
Test Quality - ValidateTestQuality() scores tests 0-100 with approval gate (Rule #16)
Screenshot Tests - ValidateScreenshotTestGeneration() enforces vision analysis workflow (Rule #17)
Router Validation - ValidateRouterExemption() ensures routing workflow integrity (Rule #18)
Rulebook Sync - ValidateDualRulebookSync() ensures JSON/MD updated together (Rule #19)
KDTR Enforcement - ValidateKDTREnforcement() ensures pattern reuse and test data publication (Rule #20)

agenticRules.statement: Routing prompts (route.prompt.md, ask.prompt.md) are EXEMPT from Step -1 governance enforcement. Routers must execute their full documented workflow (Steps 0-7) to properly detect multi-task requests and route to specialized agents. Governance enforcement belongs in execution prompts (plan, task, todo) where .github modifications actually occur, NOT in routers that only analyze and redirect.
agenticRules.rationale: Routers analyze and direct traffic but never modify .github files. Adding Step -1 to routers breaks their core workflow: (1) Skips multi-task detection (Step 1.5), (2) Bypasses plan creation handoff, (3) Prevents proper routing decisions. Enforcement at routing layer creates architectural regression. Proper enforcement point is execution prompts where .github changes actually happen.

agenticRules.statement: All rule modifications MUST update BOTH kds-rulebook.json AND kds-rulebook.md atomically in the same commit. This is MANDATORY, not optional. Desync between machine-readable (JSON) and human-readable (MD) governance creates undefined behavior and breaks the trust model.
agenticRules.rationale: The KDS governance system relies on dual-format rulebook architecture: (1) kds-rulebook.json - canonical machine-readable source for automated validation, (2) kds-rulebook.md - human-readable documentation for agent training. If only one is updated: agents may operate under different rule sets, validation logic becomes stale, documentation becomes misleading, trust in governance erodes. Both formats must stay perfectly synchronized at all times.

versionHistory.changes: Added Rule #20 (KDTR Enforcement) - KDS Test Registry System (.github/test-registry/) enforces pattern reuse before test generation and test data publication after successful execution. Integration: test-generation.prompt.md Step 1.5 (query KDTR), kds.prompt.md Rule #5 (enforcement), test orchestration scripts (atomic publication). Canonical Session 212 data (.github/test-registry/session-212/valid-tokens.json) serves as default reference for all tests. Adds ValidateKDTREnforcement() validation function. Total rules: 20 (16 mandatory + 4 governance/meta rules).

MAJOR GOVERNANCE OVERHAUL - Phase 1 (P0): Centralized Step -1 enforcement in Rule #10 (removed 4 duplicate blocks from prompts), created Algorithm 11 (ValidateAutoChainHandoffs), enhanced pre-commit hook with KDS governance enforcement. Phase 2 (P1): Created Algorithm 12 (ValidateTestOrchestration), made Step 0 (Conversation History Analysis) MANDATORY in kds.prompt.md Review Mode with auto-generated Most Violated Rules report. Phase 3 (P2): Added Algorithms 13-14 (DetectStaleRules, CalculatePromptComplexity), introduced rule sunset policy with lastValidated/validationFrequency fields, prompt complexity scoring (0-100 scale) with refactoring recommendations. Total: 4 new algorithms, centralized governance logic, automated maintenance detection.

Added Rule #19 (Dual Rulebook Sync) - MANDATORY synchronization of kds-rulebook.json and kds-rulebook.md in same commit. CRITICAL governance meta-rule ensuring machine-readable (JSON) and human-readable (MD) rulebooks never desync. Prevents undefined behavior from stale validation functions or misleading documentation. Adds ValidateDualRulebookSync() enforcement in kds.prompt.md Workflow A/B. Anti-pattern: 'update JSON now, sync MD later'. Total rules: 19 (15 mandatory + 4 governance/meta rules).

Added Rule #18 (Router Exemption) - CRITICAL architectural fix. Routing prompts (route.prompt.md, ask.prompt.md) are EXEMPT from Step -1 governance enforcement to preserve routing workflow (Steps 0-7). Step -1 removed from route.prompt.md per Rule #18. Adds ValidateRouterExemption() validation function. Prevents regression where Step -1 broke multi-task detection and plan creation. Enforcement: Automated in kds.prompt.md Workflow B. Total rules: 18 (15 mandatory + 3 governance rules).

ACHIEVED 100% Rule #1 Compliance - Extracted 45 code blocks from 7 prompts (healthcheck, cohesion, plan, route, test-prep, drift, ask) to shared/ algorithm files. Total reduction: ~655 lines. Created 7 shared reference files. All user-facing code blocks eliminated. Remaining code blocks are acceptable exceptions (JSON schemas in plan/test-prep, internal state tracking in cohesion/ask). Validation complete: P0-8 passed, compliance metrics updated in Rule #1.

Added Rule #17 (Screenshot-Based Test Generation) - Leverages GitHub Copilot vision analysis to extract click sequence metadata from numbered markers in screenshots. Integration points: test-generation.prompt.md Step 0.5, test-prep.prompt.md Step 1.5. Algorithm: screenshot-test-extraction.md with 10 helper functions. Enforcement: Semi-Automated (requires manual screenshot upload). Total rules: 17 (14 mandatory + 3 governance/testing rules).

Added Rule #15 (Git History Validation) for retroactive compliance checking and Rule #16 (Test Approval Gate) with quality scoring (0-100 scale), DRAFT/ staging, and approval workflow. Enhanced KDS governance with git history integration (Step 0.5 in kds.prompt.md) and test quality validation (Step 7.5 in test-generation.prompt.md). Added ValidateGitHistory() and ValidateTestQuality() validation functions. Total rules: 16 (14 mandatory + 2 new governance/testing rules).

ENHANCED Rule #2b Cleanup - Added data-playwright-log-marker attribute pattern (timestamp-component format), cleanup trigger modes (manual request via @workspace /cleanup-playwright-logging, post-test-generation automatic via Step 9.5), global cleanup algorithm (CleanupPlaywrightLogging function with workspace-wide marker removal), updated enforcement in test-generation.prompt.md

ENFORCED Rule #2b - Test Reverse-Engineering Metadata now mandatory for UI/API files. Added to Quick Reference, updated enforcement count to 14 rules, added ValidateTestMetadata() to enforcement list
